option.name: originalContent
option.value:
FROM python:3.11-slim
# Set working directory WORKDIR /app
# Install system dependencies RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ curl \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Install Python requirements COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
# Copy the entire backend directory structure # This creates /app/backend/app/ inside the container COPY . /app/backend/
# Create __init__.py for backend package RUN touch /app/backend/__init__.py
# Add /app to PYTHONPATH so "from backend.app..." imports work ENV PYTHONPATH=/app
# Expose the port EXPOSE 8000
# Run uvicorn with the correct module path CMD ["uvicorn", "backend.app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
